mapper.select:
SELECT s.business_name as name, COUNT(1) AS value FROM `order` o LEFT JOIN shop s ON o.merchant_id = s.id WHERE o.status = 9
and o.merchant_id = #{shopId}
and o.created_at >= concat(#{transactionCountStartDate}, ' 00:00:00')
AND o.created_at <= concat(#{transactionCountEndDate}, ' 23:59:59')
GROUP BY o.merchant_id, s.business_name ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 3

SELECT s.business_name as name, coalesce(SUM(o.transfer_amount), 0) AS value FROM `order` o LEFT JOIN shop s ON o.merchant_id = s.id WHERE o.status = 9
and o.merchant_id = #{shopId}
and o.created_at >= concat(#{transactionAmountStartDate}, ' 00:00:00')
AND o.created_at <= concat(#{transactionAmountEndDate}, ' 23:59:59')
GROUP BY o.merchant_id, s.business_name ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 3

SELECT o.merchant_id, IFNULL(sum(o.fiat_amount), 0) AS total_amount, c.code AS currency_code FROM `order` o JOIN currency c ON o.currency_id = c.id WHERE o.merchant_id = #{merchantId} and o.`status` = 9 GROUP BY o.merchant_id, c.code

SELECT o.merchant_id, IFNULL(sum(o.transfer_amount), 0) AS total_amount, c.code AS currency_code FROM `order` o JOIN currency c ON o.currency_id = c.id WHERE o.merchant_id = #{merchantId} and o.`status` = 9 GROUP BY o.merchant_id, c.code
SELECT IFNULL(sum(rolling_fee), 0) as total from `order` where merchant_id= #{merchantId}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(fiat_amount), 0) FROM `order` WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND pay_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND pay_time IS NOT NULL AND status = '9'
